sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2D fantasy platformer animation pose sheet. Reference image defines ONLY Tavi identity and illustrated rendering. Same boy, cobalt blue spiky hair, peach skin, cream rolled-sleeve tunic, red scarf and brass shoulder clasp, brown leather harness/gloves/pouch, charcoal trousers, tall brown buckled boots. Clean hand-painted outlines and shading matching reference. Create exactly SIX full-body poses in a precise equal 3-column by 2-row grid, chronological left-to-right top row then bottom row. Canvas landscape 1536x1024; each cell 512x512. All character parts and held swords inside their own cell with ample padding, no overlap. Same scale and camera in every cell. Right-facing side/three-quarter view. Each pose isolated on genuine transparent background, opaque character interiors, NO floor/shadow, no panels, no text, no numbers, no borders, no scenery. Normal standing character height approximately 390px in each 512px cell. Preserve consistent head size, costume, equipment, hand anatomy. No motion duplicates or extra limbs. Asset TAVI-028 — Knockback and recovery. Sword stays sheathed at belt, both hands free. No drawn weapon.  Six distinct poses: 1: standing ready facing right; 2: impact recoil torso thrown left, eyes wince; 3: airborne backward left with bent knees arms bracing; 4: land low crouch leaning back; 5: push upright regaining balance; 6: recover stable ready stance. No giant aura or slash effects. Strictly keep each pose completely within cell, with 40px margin. Flat transparent empty gaps without colored halos.
sources.review: selected prototype sheet; continuity cleanup pending
